verse.verse_1: By (the wind) those sent (as horses') mane (in succession),
verse.verse_4: then the criterion (the verses of Koran), separating
verse.verse_7: surely, that which you have been promised is about to fall!
verse.verse_9: and when the sky is rent asunder
verse.verse_11: and when the Messengers' time is set
verse.verse_12: to what day shall they be deferred?
verse.verse_14: Would that you knew what the Day of Decision is!
verse.verse_15: Woe on that Day to those who belied it!
verse.verse_16: Did We not destroy the ancients
verse.verse_17: and let the latter follow them?
verse.verse_18: As such shall We deal with the sinners.
verse.verse_19: Woe on that Day to those who belied it!
verse.verse_20: Did We not create you from a weak water,
verse.verse_21: which We placed within a sure lodging
verse.verse_23: We determined, how excellent a Determiner are We!
verse.verse_24: Woe on that Day to those who belied it!
verse.verse_25: Have We not made the earth a housing
verse.verse_26: for both the living and the dead?
verse.verse_27: Have We not placed high mountains upon it and filled you with sweet water?
verse.verse_28: Woe on that Day to those who belied it!
verse.verse_29: Depart to that which you belied!
verse.verse_30: Depart into the shadow of three masses,
verse.verse_31: wherein there is neither shade, nor freeing from the blazing flames
verse.verse_32: it throws spits as (high as a huge) palace,
verse.verse_34: Woe on that Day to those who belied it!
verse.verse_35: This is the Day they shall not speak,
verse.verse_36: nor shall they be given permission, so that they can apologize.
verse.verse_37: Woe on that Day to those who belied it!
verse.verse_38: Such is the Day of Decision. We will gather you with the ancients.
verse.verse_39: If you are cunning, then try your cunning against Me!
verse.verse_40: Woe on that Day to those who belied it!
verse.verse_41: Indeed, the cautious, shall live amid shades and fountains
verse.verse_42: and have such fruits as they desire.
verse.verse_43: (It shall be said to them): 'Eat and drink, with a good appetite, for all that you did'
verse.verse_44: As such We recompense those who did good.
verse.verse_45: Woe on that Day to those who belied it!
verse.verse_46: 'Eat and enjoy yourselves a little, for you are sinners'
verse.verse_47: Woe on that Day to those who belied it!
verse.verse_48: When it is said to them: 'Bow yourselves' they do not bow.
verse.verse_49: Woe on that Day to those who belied it!
verse.verse_50: After this, in what discourse will they believe?
